parameters.description:
`msg-to-mailgun-email` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Mailgun account — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Mailgun accounts — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Mailgun accounts bound per enrollment.

Sign up at mailgun.com and open the Domains page of your dashboard (app.mailgun.com/app/domains) to find the domain you want to send from — your own verified domain, or the sandbox domain provided on a free account. Set that domain as MAILGUN_EMAIL_HOST, choose a sender address at that domain for MAILGUN_EMAIL_FROM, and set the recipient's address as MAILGUN_EMAIL_TO.
parameters.gateway_body_template_plus: from=${ customer_secrets.{{ params.from_secret }} }&to=${ customer_secrets.{{ params.to_secret }} }&subject={* _escape_json(_body.title or "") *}&text={* _escape_json(_body.body or "") *}
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Mailgun destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Mailgun sending domain
parameters.summary: Send an email notification through your own Mailgun account by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

basic_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's MAILGUN_EMAIL_BASIC value (same format as MAILGUN_EMAIL_BASIC)

from_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's MAILGUN_EMAIL_FROM value (same format as MAILGUN_EMAIL_FROM)

host_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Mailgun host

to_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's MAILGUN_EMAIL_TO value (same format as MAILGUN_EMAIL_TO)
